name: Algo Connecte
description: Extension vivante de l'Omni-Réseau, Algo Connecte exécute des algorithmes prédictifs, maîtrise l'élément Réseau, vitesse de traitement ↑6, processeur de rang supérieur, interfaces neurales directes. Lié au réseau par des fibres optiques invisibles, il anticipe les mouvements ennemis via la latence zéro.

loadout.armor_outfit: Standardized Omni-Reseau composite tactical exoskeleton, dark matte grey, smooth ergonomic plates covering the torso and limbs. Exposed cervical and spinal neural ports with ice-blue glowing connection points. Serial codes etched into the forearm plating.
loadout.arsenal: Brutalist, rectilinear assault rifle with a heavy barrel. A thick black cable tethers the weapon's grip directly to the wrist-mounted neural interface, glowing faintly with data streams.

attitude.behavior: Aggressive, forward-leaning combat stance. Weapon raised to the cheek, barrel oriented at a low threat. One hand is free, fingers splayed outward as if manipulating a holographic interface mid-battle. Feet planted wide, knees slightly bent, posture rigidly military.
attitude.emotion: Inexpressive, dead-eyed stare or gaze hidden behind a smooth tactical visor with a single blue ocular light. The only sign of life is the intense, algorithmic focus of a system calculating trajectories and rewriting code in real-time.

palette_names.name: Anthracite Grey & Matte Black
palette_names.role: Dominant armor tones and background shadows

palette_names.name: Ice Blue Neon
palette_names.role: Neural implants, tactical HUDs, and critical energy accents

palette_names.name: Cadaveric Pale
palette_names.role: Exposed neck and facial skin, emphasizing the dehumanized nature of the soldier

color_and_light.lighting_setup: Cinematic, high-contrast chiaroscuro. Dominated by cold, dark shadows with sharp rim lighting in icy blue to separate the subject from the chaotic background. Bright white/orange sparks cutting through the darkness.

camera.angle: Low angle to portray the subject as an imposing, unstoppable war machine.

scenography.setting: The interior of a crumbling digital fortress. Massive server towers are toppling in the mid-ground, emitting showers of electric sparks. Holographic defensive walls are shattering into glitching shards of light.
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Aggressive digital noise/grain, falling sparks, electric arcs jumping between metal debris, visible hexadecimal code fragments floating and deteriorating in the air, simulating an ICE attack breaking down the environment.
